title: OpenBrick3D printer profile
description: One printer and tool setup and the build volume its maker publishes (profiles/printer/*.json). Read by openbrick-print as PrinterProfile with camelCase fields; rule SIZE.BED checks a part against the build volume (docs/plan/05 section 5). Hardware facts only: the fit of a printer and material lives in a fit profile. Every volume cites the page it was read from.

buildVolumeMm.description: Build volume x (width) by y (depth) by z (height) in millimetres, as the maker publishes it.

filaments.description: Filaments one job prints without a manual change: toolheads times the filaments each is fed (an AMS lite feeds four into one nozzle). At least toolheads.

source.description: Where the build volume was published: the maker's page or specification sheet, when it was read and the words on it.

notes.description: Free text. Not read by openbrick-print.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.0 names, object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names a minor version this schema knows, 1.0 (or a patch of it). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9). Unlike the other shared definitions this one follows the schema's own minor version (cargo xtask data checks it against $id).

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
